records.notes: Later value supplied by the patient; the original report and exact draw date are not available. It is not a measurement contained in the June report.

limitations: The report states that a full complement of 16 bespoke assays could not be designed from this tumour section, which may reduce clinical sensitivity. The number successfully designed is not stated.
Tumour tissue used for design was collected on 22 October 2024, rectal resection block B7. This does not independently map either supplied Natera BAM filename to tumour or normal.
No clinical interpretation or cross-patient comparison of MTM/mL is supplied.
